title: Review: Round 10 reader/ctl/tls scope
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — The codebase is generally well-structured with good test coverage and clear security defaults. The main risks are: (1) SEARCH TEXT Tantivy injection (P0, could allow cross-group query injection); (2) admin Authorization header case-sensitivity (P0, correctness break with standard HTTP clients); (3) dev mode is silently wide-open without any log warning at auth time; (4) extract_injection_source return value is discarded, making the injection_source always NntpPost regardless of SMTP drain classification.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) search_in_group implementation not in scope — cannot determine exact severity of SEARCH TEXT injection without seeing how it composes the newsgroup filter with user query; (2) msgid_map.lookup_by_cid implementation not reviewed — cannot verify XGET group-membership check is sufficient; (3) TLS crate not reviewed for client cert extraction correctness. Would raise confidence if: search_in_group and msgid_map.lookup_by_cid were also reviewed.
